reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience at this vets. The practice was spotless and smelt amazing, which made it feel really welcoming from the moment I walked in. The staff were all so friendly, professional, and genuinely caring.

They took the time to explain everything thoroughly, making sure I understood all of my options and answering every question I had. I never felt rushed, and they made both me and my pet feel completely at ease. I couldn’t have asked for better care and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a friendly and knowledgeable veterinary practice.

I was initially wary about Harrison Family vet as they were limited on rabbit reviews. Their spay pricing was alot cheaper than other highstreet vets, this included 2 post operation checks and medicine for £120!
My rabbit Willow came in for a spay, the staff were super attentive and updated me throughout the morning of the procedure. When picking her up, they explained care procedures for when she got home. She recovered well within a few days, and definately back to normal self!!

I cannot thank everyone at Harrison Family Vets enough for the wonderful care they gave my precious Tilly during her spaying procedure. From the moment we arrived, the team was kind, reassuring, and genuinely caring, which made such a difference to both of us.

Tilly means the world to me, so leaving her for surgery was emotional, but the staff kept me informed and treated her with so much love and compassion. It was clear that she was in the very best hands. Her procedure went smoothly, and her recovery has been fantastic thanks to the excellent care and advice we received.

The kindness, professionalism, and dedication shown by everyone at Harrison Family Vets truly exceeded my expectations. Knowing that there are people who care for our pets as if they were their own is priceless.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for looking after my beautiful Tilly so well. I will always be grateful and would highly recommend Harrison Family Vets to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.

A family owned veterinary practice.
It shows.
They really care about your pets.
Unlike the conglomerate practices around the UK that only care about how much money they can fleece from you.
Do yourselves a favour and register with an independently owned practice.

Could not thank the receptionist and Vet today . My dog Ozzy is such a nervous dog ,they didn't stress him out and treated him with so much care and compassion. Amazing service .. and highly recommend .x

Can not recommend Harrison’s family vets highly enough. We transferred to them when they’d newly opened as our existing vets costs for routine care just seemed to be getting ridiculous and getting an appointment seemed a challenge. Harrison’s are the complete opposite; their costs are very reasonable and have an abundance of appointments that always work for us. The ladies on reception are lovely, extremely welcoming and just what a nervous pug needs when he arrives. We have seen a few different vets, all of which have been amazing and again very accommodating to our nervous pug! Overall, so happy we made the transfer to Harrison Family Vets!

Have to give a massive thankyou to all the staff especially Chris.
Just had my 13 year old basset Dexter put to sleep
Due to mobility issues that Chris has dealt with for the past several months but today was the day to say good bye.
He gave great advise was very compassionate from the minute we arrived and was really caring towards Dexter throughout.
Thank you again to all the staff again especially Chris you are all a credit to Harrison vets in Middleton ❤️
Great vets with lovely staff. Very carrying and will also look after you as much as they will for your pet. Thank you
Best vets in the area, won't use any other now. Highest of recommendations for this place

Seriously, a massive shoutout to Zoey!

She really cares for the animals and she's always been super helpful with everything and has the best tips and advice. When our elderly cat Pixel had to be resuscitated she made me a cup of tea whilst I was waiting and that kindness was really appreciated during that hard time. She is the star of the show at Harrison's Vets ✨

The vets overall are one of the best we've been to, they always do a good job, we've had our fair share of visits, especially with our younger cat Ollie, at one point he was there every week with him popping his stitches and randomly vomiting blood. But every time we've felt he's in good hands :)

Jord, Amber, Ollie and Hannah
I was very impressed with how friendly and professional both the reception staff and the vet were. The space was clean and welcoming, and my pet was treated with great care. Highly recommended.

Really impressed with the service I received today. Unfortunately I couldn't get through to my local vet and had found myself in a distressing situation. The receptionist answered the phone promptly and put me at ease instantly. Although I fortunately did not need to take the dogs into the premises today I wanted to praise how lovely the receptionist I spoke to was and how quickly they found out the information I needed and swiftly got back to me.
A really professional and positive practice. Thank you very much 😊.

Never have I met a veterinary practice in my 56 years, where I felt like the vet & staff actually cared like the Harrison vets do. HEartbreakingly had to have our 3 year old dachshund put to sleep due to IVDD. The care, compassion & thoughtfulness of all the staff was absolutely outstanding. Cannot recommend these guys enough & they are priced really well for a vets too, others come across as money grabbing & careless but Harrison’s are far from that. A huge 5 stars in our families opinion

I bring my more unusual animals here, and because we completely trust our vet, Franc, we followed him from his previous practice. The team here are genuinely kind and welcoming, and their care makes every visit feel reassuring even for someone who has dreaded visiting the vet as much as the dentist. If I feel safe then I know my animals do too.

1st appointment  with new family puppy Winnie......amazing vets amazing reception  Amy...the care time and respect given to our puppy was amazing all areas of treatment  and facts was breathtaking  i have never been to a vets in 45 yrs who hold true care for animals would highly recommend thank you to all

Narla has had a lot of appointments at Harrisons. She is always looked after from the moment she enters the building. Treats,toys,calming wipes,a little stroke or just a lovely welcome. I cannot fault them at all. Ready to listen and discuss anything you need to. Love this vets and its staff. Xxx

Friendly staff, my kitten has being for chipping, emergency appointment and every time being its being professionally but Friendly. Separate sections for animals treats and towel to cover carrier  for anxious pets.

This weekend we rescued a 7 week old kitten, the mum was a stray cat and unfortunately she rejected the whole litter and ran away after giving birth, meaning the kittens had to be bottle fed. I was a little nervous when we got her so immediately registered her with Harrison Family Vets. I called reception and explained her story, and they were able to get us an appointment the same day. Everyone was really friendly, and once Lola (our kitten) felt comfortable they were fussing over her, which she loved. The vet we saw was fantastic and really friendly, they did a full health check on the visit which eased our minds. We mentioned we have a toddler and she might need to come to the next appointment with us. He was very encouraging of this which is really helpful when you don't have childcare. He even gave us a sticker to take home for her that day.

We signed up to the monthly 'total wellness plan' which covers the majority of services. I researched loads of vets in the area and the price for this is great in comparison. I'm sorry I didn't catch names, but we were helped by a few people and everyone was fantastic, you can tell they all clearly love animals and they made Lola feel comfortable and at ease. I would recommend this vets.

Went down as a bit of an emergency with my dogs anal gland they got me in with half an hour and seen my dog and helped me out big time was in and out within 30 mins with medication and advice very nice staff and brilliant vet

I honestly cannot thank Harrison Family Vets  enough for the incredible care they’ve shown to my rescue dogs from the very first appointment.

Walking into a new vet with rescue dogs—especially those who’ve had difficult pasts—is never easy. But from the moment we arrived, the entire team made us feel welcome, safe, and truly cared for. The receptionists were kind and understanding, and the atmosphere was calm and reassuring, which made all the difference not just for me but for my dogs, too.

Our vet was amazing—patient, gentle, and compassionate—taking the time to understand my dogs’ history and treat them with the empathy they deserve. It was such a relief to finally find a vet who sees beyond the surface and treats animals with respect and genuine care, rather than fear or impatience.

I feel incredibly lucky to have found Harrison’s. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for showing my dogs the kindness and care they’ve always deserved. You’ve gained two loyal clients for life.

Persa & Xo
Tried to get a quote for my dog. Took details but never called. Poor service
An amazing family run vets, could not of had better for my mate at the end.many thanks to the wonderful compassionate staff❤️
Great Service would highly recommend 👌 …

The staff are amazing, I love the little pods and when they spray a towel with calming solution for cats to put over there boxes did help a lot for my stressed cats with how long the journey there was, they have been brilliant with spaying and caring for my 3 princesses definitely recommended this place

Thank you guys

Overall our experience has been generally good. We had a couple of issues with Chris when we first went where we felt he wasn’t patient enough and so this put us off but we have since seen him again and it was significantly better. I would see him again.

Gerard is absolutely incredible! He is so patient, reassuring and gives such a calmness that makes us feel less stressed! We have a reactive dog and he has had to review her at least four times to be able to examine her but every time he has been so patient and not once seemed fed up of her. We are so grateful for him!

The reception staff are lovely, Claire always gives our dogs so much care! She is the only one that has ever got close enough to be able to give my reactive dog a treat. Zoe always greets our dogs with so much excitement and they love it. Amy has give some attention to the dogs which they love however, sometimes seems very distracted and in a rush. The phone manner hasn’t been the best before and sometimes Amy has been very reluctant to ask the vet for advice when we have called and instead jumps to the fact there are no appointments and that’s the end of it.

The only downside as a whole is that we never once have been seen on time for an appointment. We have waited between 10-25 minutes after our appointment every time which I know cannot be helped but it makes our reactive dog 10x worse when we stand and wait outside for her appointment as we can’t come in until we are seen.

Unfortunately I had to trap a poorly fox that needed putting to sleep. This absolutely lovely vet’s treatment of me and this poor fox was second to none. In the foxes last few moments of its life were spent with care beyond belief. I truly feel they give their all and that means so much to me as an animal lover.
Thank you all so much.
Very good vets

Love these guys as they treat my cats as if they was theirs, explained everything and even went through different prices for everything I needed so I knew how much the visit cost before I left the consultation room. My previous vet's didn't do this so I think this is awesome.
Wasn't that impressed, seemed very money driven. In a good location though.
Great customer service, very calming place for your pets.

Amazing vets all the staff are friendly and make you feel welcome, they all take there time with you when you visit the practice, I can honestly say Harrison family is by far the best vets I have ever gone to. Thank you to all of you.

Can not recommend enough! This veterinary surgery is second to none and they really care about the pets and owners who walk through their doors. My family turned up on their doorstep stressed and emotional after an appalling and upsetting time at our own vets who refused to see us because we were a few minutes late to an appointment as we hit some traffic on the way. Our dog had cancer and was deteriorating. This vets gave us amazing care and compassion and most importantly the time to let us decide what our next steps were. Our dog was able to pass peacefully with his family around and with people who I had literally just met but was able to trust 110% to look after his needs. I honestly cannot thank you enough for everything you did for us all and will forever be grateful to you 🩵
Empathetic and patient

Absolutely amazing vets, they are incredibly helpful all the staff are amazing here. Never had such a great experience with vets. They never try to push an you thing on you and genuinely just want to help the animal. Couldn't recommend them enough.

Very welcoming and made myself and my beloved fur baby feel so relaxed. Gave my dog a lot of attention which she loved.
Very happy with the service and would definitely recommend to all my family and friends.
So grateful for the same day appointment and treatment.
With love,
Brandy and Kirsty

I can’t speak highly enough of the team at Harrison Family Vets. After attending another vets, who did not take my concerns seriously, I registered at Harrison Family Vets. At the first consultation, Chris did a thorough examination, spotting things my previous vets didn’t notice. He immediately referred my pet and Chris, Gerard and the team have regularly checked in on my pet’s health since then. Chris’ quick action to refer my pet has no doubt saved my pet’s life. The team have provided excellent care for my pet and I would never go anywhere else.

Never been before but needing some advice over the Christmas holidays, Chris who I spoke to was so supportive and understanding over the phone with the conversation about saying goodbye to our dog and that support continued when we brought her in to see him. Chris listened to me with no judgement or hard selling of tests or treatment and showed us so much compassion and understanding.
Zoey was so kind to our dog but also to us, especially when we went back the following day, she was very aware of how raw it still was and how busy the waiting area was and took us into a room.
It maybe is just part of the job but at the time it felt so much more to us, which I will always be grateful for.
Very friendly vet. Had our first visit 3 days ago, staff are very helpful
Couldn't recommend this place enough!
Excellent!
Amazing vets my dog don't do people she don't know but from start to finish their was amazing with her I'm so happy iv joined up with Harrison family vets Middleton
I have had dogs for 50 years and been to numerous vets over the years and in my opinion Harrison’s vets I found outstanding from receptionist to veterinarian I would recommend very highly

This vets is amazing. We visited today with my 2 new rescue rabbits 1 who is extremely nervous. From walking in we was treated amazingly the staff truly care and it shows. The clinic is super super clean and very well maintained. The vet was running late doing a dental surgery and they couldn't apologise more for it all. We had a towel and pet remedy at hand to put over my carrier as 1 of the buns is super nervous. Xx

I took my fur baby Mr j for his first vaccination, microchipping,flea & worming treatment and I'm so glad I registered with them not only is it of high cleanliness but the minute you go through the doors your made to feel extremely welcome and it's top-notch service is amazing
We saw Gerrard he was so professional but actually gave an interest in my fur baby amazing job and I highly recommend giving this family run practice a go I can assure you 1st class all the way,so we will see you next week Gerrard when we bring one of our other fur babies princess to join and thank you for today

Visited today for first time, made to feel welcome at reception, great experience from being greeted at the car to being really patient with our nervous dog.  Very friendly and explained everything in detail.

I went in for the first time. Unfortunately I had to have my cat euthanised, all the staff were really kind, supportive and knowledgeable, provided us with all the information to make an informed decision. Very highly recommended
